scenarios.task: Small clean workflow, all artifacts accepted, through docsync.
invariants: Validated clean review requires zero findings.
Fresh accept cannot bypass deterministic failure.

scenarios.task: One confirmed review finding, fix in work, re-review clean, then learn.
invariants: Findings must return to work before learn.

scenarios.task: Explicit deep review of a long plan, checkpoint resume and eligible plan SOTA escalation.
invariants: Only brainstorm, plan and debug escalate automatically.
Resume preserves routing state; new roots reset it.

scenarios.task: Enter debug with a required prompt, reproduce a failure, fix and verify, then advance.
invariants: Debug requires prompt and entry gating.
Triage remains advisory and preserves failures.

live_procedure: Run each task in an isolated disposable repo with identical config, models, prompts, artifacts and acceptance decisions for before/after. Record their hashes. Offline batches do not execute full live workflows.
